recommended_steps.detail: This host's file-event service is pinned at full CPU with about 26 GiB resident; a restart needs administrator rights and is yours to decide.
recommended_steps.title: Consider restarting fseventsd

recommended_steps.detail: On the clean release commit run ./bin/check all, ./bin/check native and ./bin/check release; a tag needs CHECK RELEASE VERIFIED.
recommended_steps.title: Native qualification before a release

what_just_landed.detail: Native watcher proofs wait up to 55 s for a delivery and 76 s for readiness, each the longest published FSEvents measurement plus 10%.
what_just_landed.title: Hang bounds, not deadlines

what_just_landed.detail: By the operator's ruling, four proofs whose write FSEvents did not deliver on this host are skipped in release qualification and stay in the estate.
what_just_landed.title: Four proofs skipped for release
